question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The stone was also said to have __occult __powers.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"occult"** means something that is mystical, supernatural, or beyond ordinary understanding. (रहस्यमय)

 
 
• **Example: **Many ancient civilizations believed in the **occult** and practiced various rituals.
 
 
 
• **"Intelligible"** refers to something that is clear, understandable, and can be easily comprehended. (समझने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher's explanation was so **intelligible** that even the most complex concepts became clear.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'occult'** is **'intelligible'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Latent** (अव्यक्त): Something that is present but not visible or apparent; potential.

 
 
• **Example:** His** latent** talent for music became evident only after he joined the choir.
 
 
 
• **Ambiguous** (अस्पष्ट): Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were so **ambiguous** that nobody knew what to do.
 
 
 
• **Unfathomable** (अथाह): Incapable of being fully explored or understood.
 
 
• **Example:** The depths of the ocean are** unfathomable** and hold many mysteries.
